title: Quick Keto American Beef Bowl
description: A rich and gooey American dish featuring fines-herbes and ferment-jang, served in a dolsot-stone-bowl, perfect for a crowd-pleasing keto meal.

ingredients.name: fines-herbes
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs like parsley, chives, and tarragon

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the fines-herbes, ferment-jang, and butter to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet contents to a dolsot-stone-bowl.
Top the beef mixture with shredded cheddar cheese, sour cream, diced onion, and diced bell pepper.
Bake the dolsot-stone-bowl in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Quick Keto American Beef Bowl hot, garnished with additional fines-herbes if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
